title: Ride Sharing: Matching, Trip Lifecycle & Fares
summary: Uber-style core: driver availability, a nearest-driver matching strategy, a trip state machine, a pricing strategy with surge, and atomic driver assignment under contention.
hints: The service filters candidates (online, AVAILABLE, right class) and passes them to the strategy **sorted by id**. The strategy only decides which candidate is best.
Write a transition map `{ASSIGNED: [ARRIVED, CANCELLED], ARRIVED: [IN_PROGRESS, CANCELLED], IN_PROGRESS: [COMPLETED]}` and one `transition(trip, to)` helper.
Choosing a driver and marking them ON_TRIP must be one atomic step, or two riders get the same driver.
Fare: `minutes = ceil(durationMs / 60000)`, then `(base + perKm·distance + perMin·minutes) · surgePercent / 100`, all in integers.
